name: Inkling
title: Inkling: price, context window and specs
answer: Inkling is a model in Thinking Machines's Thinking Machines Inkling family, first listed on 2026-07-17. It takes text, image and audio in and returns text, with a context window of 524K tokens and up to 471K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $1 per million input tokens and $4.05 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as thinkingmachines/Inkling, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
compare: It is the oldest of the 2 versions of Thinking Machines Inkling still listed.
Its input price is the family median, $1 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
